question: Will Americans face an 8% or higher interest rate on new 30-year fixed mortgages before the end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if at least one weekly Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey® (PMMS®) release for the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage shows an average rate of 8.00% or higher, with a survey publication date strictly after 2026-10-05T18:48:57.968Z and at or before 2027-01-01T05:00:00.000Z.
- "No": Wins if every weekly PMMS® release for the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage published strictly after 2026-10-05T18:48:57.968Z and at or before 2027-01-01T05:00:00.000Z shows an average rate below 8.00%.

Clarifications:
- The rate used for each weekly comparison is the U.S. national average 30-year fixed-rate mortgage figure published in the Freddie Mac PMMS® for that week; the survey is released weekly on Thursdays (or the preceding Wednesday when Thursday is a public holiday).
